columns.name: TimeGenerated

columns.name: PsBusinessUnit
columns.description: AICall: asset business unit

columns.name: PsEnvironment
columns.description: AICall: asset environment

columns.name: PsApiSurface

columns.name: PsFallbackChain

columns.name: PsCounterfactualCostUsd
columns.description: AICall: cost on the baseline model in USD

columns.name: PsRouteEstCostUsd
columns.description: AICall: router's cost estimate before the call, USD

columns.description: AICall: latency in milliseconds

columns.name: PsAuditPrevHash
columns.description: Audit: row_hash of the previous row

columns.name: PsAuditRowHash
columns.description: Audit: sha256 over prev_hash and the canonical row

columns.name: PsAuditHashVersion
columns.description: Audit: hash algorithm version

columns.description: Audit: ids, counts and names (never secrets or free text)
